en.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

zhSimplified.text: 义人哪，你们应当靠耶和华欢乐； 正直人的赞美是合宜的。

zhTraditional.text: 義人哪，你們應當靠耶和華歡樂； 正直人的讚美是合宜的。

en.text: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

zhSimplified.text: 你们应当弹琴称谢耶和华， 用十弦瑟歌颂他。

zhTraditional.text: 你們應當彈琴稱謝耶和華， 用十弦瑟歌頌他。

en.text: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

zhSimplified.text: 应当向他唱新歌， 弹得巧妙，声音洪亮。

zhTraditional.text: 應當向他唱新歌， 彈得巧妙，聲音洪亮。

en.text: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华的言语正直； 凡他所做的尽都诚实。

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華的言語正直； 凡他所做的盡都誠實。

en.text: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 他喜爱仁义公平； 遍地满了耶和华的慈爱。

zhTraditional.text: 他喜愛仁義公平； 遍地滿了耶和華的慈愛。

en.text: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 诸天借耶和华的命而造； 万象借他口中的气而成。

zhTraditional.text: 諸天藉耶和華的命而造； 萬象藉他口中的氣而成。

en.text: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

zhSimplified.text: 他聚集海水如垒， 收藏深洋在库房。

zhTraditional.text: 他聚集海水如壘， 收藏深洋在庫房。

en.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

zhSimplified.text: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华！ 愿世上的居民都惧怕他！

zhTraditional.text: 願全地都敬畏耶和華！ 願世上的居民都懼怕他！

en.text: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他说有，就有， 命立，就立。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他說有，就有， 命立，就立。

en.text: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使列国的筹算归于无有， 使众民的思念无有功效。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使列國的籌算歸於無有， 使眾民的思念無有功效。

en.text: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的筹算永远立定； 他心中的思念万代常存。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的籌算永遠立定； 他心中的思念萬代常存。

en.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 以耶和华为 神的，那国是有福的！ 他所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的！

zhTraditional.text: 以耶和華為上帝的，那國是有福的！ 他所揀選為自己產業的，那民是有福的！

en.text: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华从天上观看； 他看见一切的世人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華從天上觀看； 他看見一切的世人。

en.text: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

zhSimplified.text: 从他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民—

zhTraditional.text: 從他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民－

en.text: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

zhSimplified.text: 他是那造成他们众人心的， 留意他们一切作为的。

zhTraditional.text: 他是那造成他們眾人心的， 留意他們一切作為的。

en.text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

zhSimplified.text: 君王不能因兵多得胜； 勇士不能因力大得救。

zhTraditional.text: 君王不能因兵多得勝； 勇士不能因力大得救。

en.text: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

zhSimplified.text: 靠马得救是枉然的； 马也不能因力大救人。

zhTraditional.text: 靠馬得救是枉然的； 馬也不能因力大救人。

en.text: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的眼目看顾敬畏他的人 和仰望他慈爱的人，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的眼目看顧敬畏他的人 和仰望他慈愛的人，

en.text: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

zhSimplified.text: 要救他们的命脱离死亡， 并使他们在饥荒中存活。

zhTraditional.text: 要救他們的命脫離死亡， 並使他們在饑荒中存活。

en.text: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的心向来等候耶和华； 他是我们的帮助，我们的盾牌。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的心向來等候耶和華； 他是我們的幫助，我們的盾牌。

en.text: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的心必靠他欢喜， 因为我们向来倚靠他的圣名。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的心必靠他歡喜， 因為我們向來倚靠他的聖名。

en.text: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你照着我们所仰望你的， 向我们施行慈爱！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你照着我們所仰望你的， 向我們施行慈愛！
